account_sign_out_failed: We couldn't sign you out. Check your connection and try again.
signin_intro_native: We'll open a secure Deskohub page where you sign in with your email.
signin_in_progress: Finish signing in on the Deskohub page.
signin_sent_body: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device, or enter the code from the email.
signin_continue_as_body: You're already signed in on this browser. Continue to return to the app.
signin_reauthenticate_body: Sign in again to confirm it's you.
callback_signed_in_web: You're signed in. Return to the app, or continue in this browser.
signin_error_cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. You can try again.
signin_error_link: This sign-in link can't be used here. Start signing in again.
signin_error_expired: This sign-in took too long and expired. Start again.
signin_error_rejected: This sign-in link was already used or has expired. Request a new one.
signin_error_unavailable: We couldn't reach Deskohub. Check your connection and try again.
signin_error_account_switch: You signed in to a different account. Sign in with the account you use in the app.
signin_error_not_signed_in: You're signed out. Sign in and try again.
signin_error_automated: We couldn't verify this browser. Open Deskohub in your usual browser and try again.
signin_error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
signin_error_address_limit: We've already sent several sign-in emails to this address. Use the latest one or try again later.
signin_error_wrong_code: That code isn't right. Check the email and try again.
signin_error_expired_code: That code has expired. Request a new sign-in email.
signin_error_too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Request a new sign-in email.
signin_error_session_not_fresh: Sign in again to continue to the app.
consent_prompt_message: May we measure how you use the app so we can improve it?
signin_error_reauth_unconfirmed: We couldn't confirm this is the same account, so you were signed out. Sign in again.
signin_error_reauth_storage: This browser won't store what we need to confirm it's you. Allow site storage for Deskohub and try again.
passkey_sign_in_failed: Signing in with a passkey didn't work. Try again, or use your email.
passkey_sign_in_no_credential: This device has no passkey for Deskohub. Sign in with your email instead.
passkey_unsupported: Passkeys aren't available on this device.
passkey_added: Passkey created. You can sign in with it next time.
passkey_add_failed: The passkey wasn't created. Try again.
passkey_add_already_registered: This device already has a passkey for your account.
reauthentication_in_progress: Sign in again on the Deskohub page to confirm it's you.
reauthentication_confirmed: You've confirmed it's you. Try again now.
account_error_unavailable: We couldn't reach Deskohub. Check your connection and try again.
account_error_timeout: Deskohub is taking too long to answer. Check your connection and try again.
account_error_rate_limited: You've refreshed a lot in a short time. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
account_save_unconfirmed: We couldn't confirm your change. This is what Deskohub has saved now.
account_notice_completion_required: Complete your profile to see your reservations and billing details.
account_notice_support_required: Your account needs our help before we can show your profile and reservations. Contact Deskohub support.
account_notice_unavailable: We can't show your profile and reservations right now. Try again later.
account_notice_deletion_pending: Your account deletion is in progress.
account_sample_data_banner: Sample data: nothing here is real.
reservations_past_empty: You have no past reservations yet.
reservations_empty: You don't have any reservations yet.
reservations_last_updated: Last updated {time}. You're seeing the reservations saved on this device.
reservations_order_created_body: Your payment isn't ready yet. If you've just started the reservation, go back to booking and try again.
reservations_order_pending_title: Your payment is still being processed.
reservations_order_pending_body: We're waiting for the payment provider to confirm it, and this screen checks again by itself. If the Nexi payment page is still open, finish the payment there. You don't need to book again.
reservations_order_payment_pending_delay: We still can't confirm your payment.
If your payment went through, the reservation is yours. Don't book again until we confirm your payment or you hear from us, or you might pay twice. Contact us and we'll check it.
reservations_order_paid_waiting_fulfillm: Payment received. We're finishing your reservation.
This screen checks again by itself until we send your confirmation and access details. You don't need to book again.
reservations_order_paid_fulfillment_dela: Your payment went through, but finishing your reservation is taking longer.
Your reservation is saved, but your confirmation and access details haven't gone out yet. You don't need to book again. Contact us and we'll get your access to you.
reservations_order_paid_awaiting_deliver: Your reservation is paid and confirmed.
We've emailed your confirmation and access link. It usually arrives within a few minutes, and this screen checks again by itself. You don't need to book again.
reservations_order_paid_delivery_delayed: Your reservation is confirmed, but the email hasn't arrived yet.

We sent your confirmation and access link, but we can't confirm it was delivered. The email may be delayed, or the address may contain a typo. You don't need to book again. Contact us and we'll get your access to you.
reservations_order_fulfilled_body: Your payment is complete and we've emailed you your access details.
reservations_order_fulfillment_failed_bo: Your payment went through and your reservation is saved, but your confirmation and access link didn't reach your email. You don't need to book again. Contact us and we'll get your access to you.
reservations_order_payment_failed_body: The payment didn't go through, so we haven't issued access for this order. Start a new reservation to try again.
reservations_order_cancelled_body: The payment was cancelled, so we haven't issued access for this order. Start a new reservation to try again.
reservations_order_expired_body: The payment wasn't completed in time, so we released the reserved slot. Start a new reservation to try again.
reservations_order_late_payment_checking: Your payment arrived after the reservation hold expired, so we're checking that the space is still available. This screen checks again by itself.
reservations_order_late_payment_refund_b: Your payment arrived after the reservation was no longer available, so we couldn't confirm it and will refund the payment. Start a new reservation if you still want to book.
reservations_order_late_payment_review_b: Your payment arrived after the reservation hold expired, and we need to check your reservation manually. Contact us so we can confirm the reservation or refund the payment.
reservations_order_not_found: We couldn't find this reservation. It may belong to another account.
reservations_refresh_scheduled: This screen checks again by itself in a moment.
reservations_refresh_paused: Automatic checks are paused to save requests. Tap Refresh to check again.
reservations_refresh_ended: This screen has stopped checking by itself. Tap Refresh to check again.
reservations_invoice_not_issued: The invoice hasn't been issued yet. Try again later.
reservations_invoice_not_found: We couldn't find an invoice for this reservation.
reservations_invoice_share_failed: We couldn't open the invoice on this device. Try again.
